solutionSource.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

indicatorNotes.at: one piece is placed at, right beside, the other

annotation.surface: An additional song or routine performed at a formal dance.
annotation.walkthrough: In cricket a no ball is an illegal delivery; it gives the batting side a run, one of the 'extras' not scored off the bat.
annotation.definitionFit: A no ball adds a run to the total as one of cricket's extras.

blocks.note: a silly person, as in 'you goose'

annotation.walkthrough: Goose egg reads as one thing, even as the American slang for zero; split it into two separate definitions.
annotation.definitionFit: A nit is both a fool (short for nitwit) and a louse's egg.

annotation.definitionNote: bunch is a collective hint: bananas grow and are sold in bunches

blocks.note: what a bunch is typically of

annotation.surface: A group of people who are all a bit mad.
annotation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that bunch is only a hint: bananas are the fruit most often bought by the bunch.
annotation.definitionFit: Two senses: an informal idiom for wild or mad, and the fruit that is sold in hands, or bunches.

indicatorNotes.destroyed: the letters are broken up and rebuilt

annotation.surface: Principles held in Chile wrecked the nation.
annotation.walkthrough: The surface puts us in South America; the answer is a tiny Alpine state between Switzerland and Austria.
annotation.definitionFit: Liechtenstein is a small principality in central Europe.

entries.clue: Old musical which contains old piano (3,3)

indicatorNotes.contains: the first word holds the letters inside it

blocks.note: that and which are both relative pronouns

annotation.surface: A vintage show that features an antique piano.
annotation.walkthrough: Which looks like a mere joining word, but it is the wordplay's outer piece, THAT.
annotation.definitionFit: Top Hat is the 1935 Fred Astaire and Ginger Rogers film musical.

entries.clue: Last drink available at motorway services? (3,3,3,4)

annotation.definition: Last drink available at motorway services?

blocks.note: the surface reading: a final drink before leaving a pub or party
the setter's twist: taken literally, a drink sold for people travelling on the road

annotation.surface: Wondering whether a service station sells a final drink.
annotation.walkthrough: Motorway services are British roadside service stations; the joke takes 'for the road' literally.
annotation.definitionFit: One for the road is a last drink taken before setting off home.

entries.clue: Capital of Hungary, a number one capital! (5)

indicatorNotes.Capital of: a capital letter is the first one, so take the first letter

annotation.surface: Budapest is the capital of Hungary, praised here as a first-rate city.
annotation.walkthrough: Capital is used twice: first for a capital letter, then for a capital city, which is the definition.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: the city is the seat of government of Vietnam.

indicatorNotes.knitted: the letters are worked together into a new pattern

annotation.surface: A relative called April made a waterproof garment on her needles.
annotation.walkthrough: Knitted wool is hardly waterproof, which is the joke of the picture.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain description: the word names a heavy canvas sheet, tarred or coated to keep rain off.

indicatorNotes.cut: the word is cut short, losing its last letter

annotation.surface: Handling sharp metal and ending up with a cut.
annotation.walkthrough: Touch reads as a verb; it is the noun, a slight trace, as in 'a touch of red'.
annotation.definitionFit: A tinge is a touch, a slight amount of colour or quality.

entries.clue: Bran ultimately required in variety of cereal — daily? (7)

indicatorNotes.ultimately: ultimately means at the end, so take the last letter
indicatorNotes.variety of: a variety is a different arrangement of the letters

annotation.surface: Asking whether bran is a necessary part of a breakfast cereal eaten every day.
annotation.walkthrough: Daily reads as an adjective about breakfast; in Britain a daily is a cleaner who comes in each day.
annotation.definitionFit: A daily is a domestic cleaner, from 'daily help'.

indicatorNotes.hooks: the first word hooks, catches and holds, the letter inside it

blocks.note: a cap is a lid or top

annotation.surface: Advice on the best hooks to use when fishing.
annotation.walkthrough: Top hooks reads as first-rate fishing tackle; hooks is really the container instruction.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: a common freshwater species, often stocked in ponds and lakes for anglers.

indicatorNotes.short: the word is cut short, losing its last letter

annotation.surface: A lad humming a brief melody.
annotation.walkthrough: With is only glue; the shortening happens to tune, not to boy.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: both words name a male child in relation to his parents.

annotation.surface: Asking how an American examination alters its course.
annotation.walkthrough: The definition hides at the end as the object of changes; the fodder is the first three words.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: one of the intercardinal points, halfway between two main compass points.

entries.clue: Instrument in choir a man played (9)

indicatorNotes.played: the letters are played with, moved about

annotation.surface: A man in the choir played an instrument.
annotation.walkthrough: Played sits naturally with instrument, but it is working on the letters before it.
annotation.definitionFit: A definition by example: the small reed instrument played by blowing and sucking across its holes, also called a mouth organ.

indicatorNotes.shaping: the letters are given a new shape

annotation.surface: An Irish province determining the outcome of something.
annotation.walkthrough: Historic Irish province is the whole definition; shaping works on result alone.
annotation.definitionFit: Ulster is one of the four historic provinces of Ireland.

indicatorNotes.on: one piece goes on after the other

blocks.note: to roll is to sway from side to side

annotation.surface: Swaggering down the street.
annotation.walkthrough: In an across clue, one thing on another puts it after: sway follows street.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: an unhurried, leisurely walk, as in an evening turn round the park.

indicatorNotes.moving: things that are moving shift position, so these letters shift into a new order

annotation.surface: Coping with a relocation to Tulsa, Oklahoma.
annotation.walkthrough: Moving reads as relocating to the Oklahoma city; it is the signal to rearrange the two words.
annotation.definitionFit: To outlast is to survive longer than something else.

entries.clue: Defeat: head hidden in photo finish? (4)

indicatorNotes.head hidden: the first letter is hidden away, removed

blocks.note: a glossy coating is one finish for a photographic print

annotation.surface: A race lost by a whisker, with the winner's head just visible in the photo finish.
annotation.walkthrough: Photo finish suggests a tight race; it is really a type of print surface, gloss or matt.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: what a beaten team records in the results column.

entries.clue: Good Lord, puff announcing new Pope? (4,5)

blocks.note: white smoke from the Sistine Chapel signals that a Pope has been elected

annotation.surface: An exclamation at the white smoke over the Vatican.
annotation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the second reading as playful: the smoke really is holy.
annotation.definitionFit: Holy smoke! is an exclamation of surprise, like Good Lord!

entries.clue: Flower left in higher place at home (5)

blocks.note: up means in a higher place
to be in is to be at home

annotation.surface: A flower left upstairs in the house.
annotation.walkthrough: Higher place and at home look like one location; they give two separate pieces.
annotation.definitionFit: The lupin is a garden flower with tall spikes of blooms.

entries.clue: I appreciate that head on naked bronze (3)

indicatorNotes.head on: the head, first letter, of the next word goes on after

annotation.surface: Thanking someone for admiring the bronzed look of a nude sunbather.
annotation.walkthrough: Ta is everyday British for thank you.
annotation.definitionFit: Bronze and tan both mean a sun-browned skin colour.

indicatorNotes.onto: one piece is put onto, after, the other

blocks.note: an ex is a former partner

annotation.surface: An order to aim the papers straight at an ex.
annotation.walkthrough: Direct reads as a verb in the surface; it is the adjective, as in an express train.
annotation.definitionFit: Express means direct, as a train that runs fast with few stops.

entries.clue: Give a lecture hosted by governor at Eton (5)

indicatorNotes.hosted by: the answer is a guest inside the words that follow

annotation.surface: A school governor holding a talk at Eton.
annotation.walkthrough: Eton is England's most famous boarding school; here only its E is needed.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: to speak at length in a formal, often pompous, way, as a lecturer might.

annotation.surface: A technical description of an organ that picks up sound.
annotation.walkthrough: The whole clue both spells the answer and defines it: an ear is an auditory receptor.
annotation.definitionFit: An &lit: the whole clue reads straight, since the organ of hearing is exactly the body's receptor for sound.

entries.clue: Figure resident of nest is rent payer (6)

annotation.surface: A bird in its nest cast as someone paying rent.
annotation.walkthrough: Resident of nest suggests a bird, but it is an ant.
annotation.definitionFit: A plain description: the person occupying a property under a lease, paying a landlord for it.

entries.clue: Journalist tried novel: nothing in it (6)

indicatorNotes.novel: novel means new, so the letters take a new order
indicatorNotes.in it: the letter goes inside the rearranged word

annotation.surface: A journalist attempted a novel, which turned out empty.
annotation.walkthrough: Novel looks like the noun, a book; it is the adjective, new, calling for an anagram.
annotation.definitionFit: An editor is a journalist in charge of a publication or section.
